script: About $67,000 buys 350 horsepower without turbos. This is the 2015 Porsche 911 Carrera Coupe. Porsche introduced the 991 in 2011 with a wheelbase stretched by 100 millimeters over the 997. The body got lighter. Porsche fitted bi-xenon headlights as standard equipment, with automatic activation when daylight fades. Those rear LEDs respond faster than conventional bulbs, so following drivers get the braking signal sooner. SOUL supplies this muffler you’re looking at here. The naturally aspirated 3.4-liter flat-six produces 350 horsepower and 287 pound-feet of torque with variable valve timing and lift. One of the five instrument pods actually houses a configurable screen for navigation, vehicle information, and audio. The seven-speed PDK drives the rear wheels through two clutches and preselects the next gear before you shift. They go for about $67,000 today, but would you choose this naturally aspirated Carrera over a newer turbocharged one?

sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2015 Porsche 911 Carrera Coupe, finished in black with a black interior. The odometer on this 911 currently displays approximately 35,800 miles. This Porsche has reportedly been registered in Florida and California since 2018. According to the build sheet provided in the gallery, notable factory equipment includes the Bose Audio Package, 20-inch Carrera S wheels, SportDesign side mirrors, and instrument dials and seat belts in Guards Red. Notable modifications reported by the seller include a SOUL Performance muffler, Öhlins Road & Track DFV coilovers, an aftermarket front lip, an aftermarket steering wheel, and Apple CarPlay compatibility. Porsche introduced the 991-generation 911 for the 2012 model year. It arrived as an evolution of its predecessor, the 997, and it received more powerful engines across the board and a more luxurious interior. It was longer, lower, and wider — and it relied extensively on aluminum to avoid putting on weight. Power comes from a 3.4-liter flat-6, rated at 350 horsepower and 287 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 7-speed PDK dual-clutch automatic transmission.
